claude.rationale: The deal was structured as a sale of all outstanding stock of the parent holding company of Comunicaciones Nextel de México, so the operating subsidiary transferred "as a going concern rather than as a set of carved-out assets," carrying product, processes and organization together within one legal vehicle (T4/T5/T6 all move 1-1 via the equity sale). The pre-closing covenant required Nextel Mexico to conduct business in the ordinary course and "maintain and preserve intact its business organization" and business/regulatory relationships — i.e., "the customer-facing product, the operating processes and the operating organization were to be held together and preserved within the transferred entity through closing," so no product-vs-process (gap_45) or process-vs-organization (gap_56) structural mismatch exists at closing. Because nothing was carved out, both gaps are 0 and mitigation is NA; T1 is coded replace as NII's controlling intent exited and AT&T's was installed.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was structured as a sale of all outstanding stock of the parent of the operating company, Nextel Mexico, transferring it as a going concern. The seller covenanted to preserve intact the business organization, relationships, and operations through closing, ensuring the product (T4), processes (T5), and organization (T6) transferred together without structural gaps.

grok.rationale: The deal was structured as a §363 stock sale of all outstanding shares of the parent of operating subsidiary Nextel Mexico, transferring that entity as a going concern rather than carved-out assets. A pre-closing covenant required Nextel Mexico to conduct business in the ordinary course and use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain and preserve intact its business organization and relationships, so the customer-facing wireless product (T4), operating processes (T5), and organization (T6) were held together inside the transferred entity through closing. No product-vs-process or process-vs-organization structural mismatch at closing is documented; therefore gap_45=0 and gap_56=0.
